_readme: Optional additions to the Campfire deck. The 265-card base deck is embedded in games/campfire.html and ships without this file. Written by scripts/campfire.js on the nightly cron. Safe to delete, empty, or break — the page falls back to the base deck silently. Schema: each level array holds {min, q}. min is the youngest age the card is written for (4, 7, 10, 12, 13, or 18). Duplicate question text is rejected client-side.

spark.q: If you could ride to school on any animal, which one would you pick?
What is the silliest face you can make, and who here does it best?
If our pet could talk for one minute, what do you think it would say first?

kindling.q: What is something small that happened this week that you have not told anyone about?
What is a place you used to love that does not feel the same anymore?
When have you noticed yourself acting differently just to fit in with a group?

bonfire.q: What is something you changed your mind about that you are not ready to admit to the people who agreed with you?
When have you stayed silent while someone was treated badly, and what stopped you from speaking?
What is a friendship you know is ending, and are you letting it?

dare.q: Everyone stand up and copy whatever the youngest person here does until they sit back down.
Draw a picture of the person across from you in thirty seconds and hand it to them to keep.
Describe your whole day today using only sounds, and let the table guess what happened.
Everyone move like the animal you would be, all at once, until someone shouts stop.
Build the tallest tower you can out of whatever is on this table before the next person finishes counting to twenty.
Hand your drink to the person on your left and let them make a toast about you.

embers.q: What do you need from me that you have stopped asking for because I did not deliver the first few times?
When the kids are grown and gone, what do you hope is still between us?
What part of your day do you look forward to that has nothing to do with anyone in this house?
What do you spend money on that you would be embarrassed to defend out loud?
What would have to change for you to stop bracing for something to go wrong?
Which apology are you waiting for that is probably never coming?

roast.q: Who in this family would be the worst at pretending to be a statue?
If everyone here were a sound the fridge makes, which sound is each person?
If this family were put in charge of a zoo for one day, who lets something out?
Who in this family would be the worst at sharing a bag of sweets, and who would hand out too many?
If this family discovered a new planet, whose name for it do we all quietly ignore?
Who here would be the worst person put in charge of a school trip full of teenagers, and what is the first thing to go wrong?
